_comment: The agent gate's additions to tests/spine/allowlist.json. run.sh merges the two
into .test-output/agent/allowlist.json (lists concatenated, cross_implementation
keys refused if both files name one) and compares through the merged copy, so
nothing here loosens the apply gates.
run_to_run: fields that differ between two `puppet agent -t` runs on ONE node.
Measured 2026-11-16 from the agent gate's Ruby run 1 against its run 2:
catalog_uuid 81d1c69d-... against 273ceed1-... (each compile mints one, so
the apply gates, which hand both sides one catalog file, never see it vary);
startup_time 1.359451704 against 0.416595999; plugin_sync 0.357259556 against
0.300215325; fact_generation 0.553457542 against 0.532411848; convert_catalog
0.031244258 against 0.038862475; config_retrieval 0.607902966 against
0.229451645; vox_marker 0.001095281 against 0.000121422. config_retrieval is
compared as a value on the apply gates, where both sides report a structural 0;
an agent retrieves a catalog, so here it is a duration like the others.
cross_implementation: the gate compares two NODES, ruby.example.test and
vox.example.test, so identity differs by construction; and the D-rows of
docs/maintainers/apply-spine.md that only an agent run shows.
'logs (Puppet: Caching catalog for <host>)' is a documentation key like the
spine's 'logs (Puppet: Wrapped exception)': it matches no path, and the drop it
declares is reportcmp's dropCachingCatalogLog, Ruby side only.

cross_implementation.host: two nodes compared: identity differs by construction -- each report's host is its own certname
cross_implementation.metrics.resources.values.total.value: D-75 (docs/maintainers/apply-spine.md): Ruby's agent adds Puppet's six default schedules and the default filebucket to every catalog (catalog.rb make_default_resources) and counts them; voxagent does not. run.sh asserts the remainder instead: Ruby's total minus 7 must equal voxagent's
cross_implementation.metrics.time.values.schedule.label: D-75: the default schedules' per-type timing, Ruby only
cross_implementation.metrics.time.values.schedule.value: D-75: the default schedules' per-type timing, Ruby only
cross_implementation.metrics.time.values.filebucket.label: D-75: the default filebucket's per-type timing, Ruby only
cross_implementation.metrics.time.values.filebucket.value: D-75: the default filebucket's per-type timing, Ruby only
cross_implementation.metrics.time.values.node_retrieval.label: D-76 (docs/maintainers/apply-spine.md): voxagent requests the node on every run; Ruby, once a lastrunfile exists, skips the request and its timing
cross_implementation.metrics.time.values.node_retrieval.value: D-76: as the label; when both sides time it, a duration
cross_implementation.logs (Puppet: Caching catalog for <host>: D-67 (docs/maintainers/apply-spine.md): voxagent caches no catalog, so never logs configurer.rb:495's 'Caching catalog for <certname>'. Dropped from the RUBY side only, and only with source Puppet, level info and the report's own host, so the line from voxagent or in any other wording still diverges
